BiblicalUsage: Pâlâh is to distinguish, to set apart, to mark out. The LORD severs the land of Goshen so no swarms of flies are there, Moses pleads that God's going with them is what separates Israel from all the people on the earth, and the psalmist says the LORD has set apart him that is godly for Himself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the heart of being God's people. He marks us out, He goes with us, and that going-with is what makes us different from every other people.
